description: This file defines a Spring Data repository interface named CustomerRepository, which extends CrudRepository for Customer entities identified by a String. It includes a custom method findByCustomerNumber to retrieve customers by their customer number.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for Customer entities with custom query method findByCustomerNumber.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the Customer with the given customer number if present.
